notes.subject: ⟨ye⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew verbless clause 'you — my help and my deliverer' requires the Bambara copula ye

notes.subject: יחשב לי
notes.rationale: 'Adonay thinks/plans/accounts for me' — KJV 'thinketh upon me' vs JPS 'will account it unto me' vs YLT 'doth devise for me'; miiri keeps the bare 'think'

notes.subject: yelendilatigi
notes.rationale: ומפלטי is literally 'my escape-place', rendered as agent noun 'my deliverer' after the traditional versions

notes.subject: to Elohim
notes.rationale: Direct second-person plea closing the psalm: 'my God, do not delay'

translation: Nka ne ye miskin ye ani mɔgɔ min ma fosi sɔrɔ; Adonay b'a miiri ne kan; ne dɛmɛ ani ne yelendilatigi, i de ⟨ye⟩; ne Elohim, kana lati.

tokens.gloss: ani mɔgɔ min ma fosi sɔrɔ
